text:
morgan: quick follow-up from the RFC meeting — we still need a decision on failover behavior across Hosted/Dedicated/Private
anya: do we reject on incompatible protocol or attempt graceful downgrade?
sam: pragmatic: downgrade for latency-sensitive hosted endpoints, reject for billing/tenant-critical paths
lee: for Private, default to strict (reject) unless tenant explicitly opts into fallthrough
anya: so two axes: safety (strict vs fallthrough) and audit (required vs optional)
rachel: add an audit hook so we can alert on rising fallthrough rates
ops-bot: deploy-check: canary uses fallthrough=true, prod uses fallthrough=false
morgan: proposal: negotiation RPC returns (compat_score, suggested_variant). if score >= threshold => route. else if tenant.policy.allow_fallthrough => route to fallback and emit audit event. else reject with remediation link
anya: example policy: {"compat_threshold":"0.8","allow_fallthrough":"false","audit_level":"required"}
sam: scoring: feature intersection weighted by streaming, function_calling, kv_cache semantics
lee: treat tokenizer fingerprint mismatch as hard-fail unless tenant accepts tokenization differences
rachel: store 30d histogram of fallthroughs per tenant; alert on regressions
lee: impl notes: negotiation as lightweight RPC, cache decisions per (tenant, model_variant, seq_profile), expose metrics compat.score, compat.fallthrough_count, compat.reject_count
anya: metric names: compat.score, compat.fallthrough_count, compat.reject_count, compat.fingerprint_mismatch
ops-bot: created INF-2384 for negotiation RPC + caching
morgan: next steps: anya drafts addendum with policy schema and defaults; sam will add ops latency constraints; lee will write tokenizer hard-fail section; rachel will add observability panels. sync Friday 10am :thumbsup:
